text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for my debut! I've been really looking forward to today, but…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The crowd seems worried about how young I am, and they appear to doubt whether Trainer is doing a good job supporting me…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: If I work really hard, will people eventually acknowledge and praise Trainer too?
